evidence: Extensively updates transaction creation, coin selection, fee-bumping, and recipient database persistence across `src/wallet/spend.cpp`, `src/wallet/feebumper.cpp`, and `src/wallet/walletdb.cpp`.
rationale: Adds wallet and RPC support for sending transactions to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses using `send`, `sendtoaddress`, `sendmany`, and `sendall`. It introduces dynamic taproot output derivation based on selected spending inputs, adapts coin selection, and persists recipient metadata to enable RBF fee-bumping, delivering a major user-facing privacy capability.
